_doc: Winter play (docs/winter_play.md): the source of Content/City/winter_play.json and the people's winter places. Places in the terrace frame (s metres inland from the sea line, y along the coast, as tools/city_plan.py). Times are local hours, weekdays 0 = Monday. Words: strings.json. Run python3 tools/winter_play/winter_play.py after a change.

rink._doc: The park pond's ice (public_spaces.json waters 'pond'): the skaters' loop inset from the kerb, their slots on it.

banya._doc: A log banya on the sand under the seawall north of the pier's root (lounger rows keep 14 m clear of the pier). size: depth (along -s, to the sea), width (along y), wall height, m. The dressing room by the door, the steam room behind it (box: centre in the banya's frame, x to the door, y left, z up; half sizes).

ice_hole._doc: The walruses' hole off the pier's north side (the pier: axis y 905, 12 m deck ~1.5 m over the datum, s 25 .. -140). The first s out along it where the bed is depth_m under winter low water; the hole is one 3 m tile of the sea ice's solid grid (tile_m), snapped.

ice._doc: The pond's ice: frozen on the calendar from 'from' to 'to' (as ALyudPublicSpaces draws it; lyud.City.Ice forces it), thickness by Stefan's law from the weather's freezing degree-days past an offset, eaten by a thaw. The rink is open from open_cm; under thick_cm the cracks are many and wide.

skating._doc: The hero on skates (m, s): a push every stroke while a move key is held, a long glide, turns limited by the edge's grip, S into a hockey stop. A crack crossed fast or a turn past the grip may throw him. Without skates the ice is slippery. With skates on land he totters.

banya_rules._doc: When the banya is heated (days, hours; dates MM-DD override), what entering costs, the steam room (deg C) and the body's heat 0..1: it rises with the room's felt heat (the air plus the steam's bite; the felt hat takes some off), a venik's swish adds a little, out of the room it falls (fast in snow, faster in cold water). A round: heat over round_hot in the steam room, then under round_cool by snow or the sea within round_window_s.

walrus._doc: Cold water: the cold builds while he swims (faster the colder the sea), the banya's heat soaks it up first; past 1 he must get out, past out_cold the walruses haul him onto the deck. A swim counts from count_s. The walruses' club swims on Sunday mornings in season; everybody who dares on New Year's morning.

snowball._doc: G with the hand free of feed on snow that packs: scoop, then throw. Snow packs from pack_cm deep between the two temperatures (dry cold snow will not hold), better when wet.

fight._doc: Children at play outdoors near the hero join when one is hit or a snowball lands near: they throw back every few seconds (a lead on his run, an error growing with the distance) until the time is up or he walks off.

snowman._doc: Crouch and E on snow that packs: a ball to roll; it grows as he pushes it (its area picks up the snow it rolls over). E leaves it; E with a small enough ball at a bigger one lifts it on. Three balls are a snowman; then E puts on a carrot nose, coal eyes and twig arms if he has them. A thaw slumps them.

stamps._doc: The collection 'winter' (ULyudCityThings::GiveStamp): each piece and what gives it.

radio._doc: The town radio's weather adds the rink (docs/music.md): open with the thickness, thin, slush; the walruses invite on Saturday evening's news.
